estilo: Cinematic still photograph, 35mm film, shot at night unless stated, muted desaturated colors, low contrast, cold tones, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, realistic, American Midwest, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

planos.prompt: A tiny rural town at night seen from a car on the highway: one blinking stoplight and a tall grain elevator lit up like a ship, then darkness beyond.
Taillights of a pickup truck ahead on a narrow dark road turning off onto a dirt road at an unmarked crossroads, its lights going out, fields all around.
Through the rear window of an old dark green station wagon at night: a child's booster seat with a worn stuffed rabbit sitting in it facing backward, small sneakers on the floor mat, dim dome light.
A car rearview mirror at night reflecting a small rural gas station behind, an old station wagon with its dome light on, getting farther away.
A middle-aged waitress's hand refilling a mug of coffee from a glass pot at a diner table at night, rain on the window behind, warm light, face not visible.
Close up on a young man's wrist resting on a diner table: an old cheap digital watch showing the time, rain-darkened denim jacket sleeve beside it, warm light.
Seen from standing at the end of a diner booth: a young couple seated, the woman staring out the dark window, the man looking up with tired red eyes, faces in soft shadow, unsettling stillness.
